title: Incremental ingestion and operability

files.change: Separate health serving from bounded historical work; preserve established daily schedule initially.
Subject registry enumeration, resumable per-provider checkpoints and stale-source checks.
Explicit bounded refresh/backfill modes with --company and --dry-run.
Resource constraints verified against VPS capacity; add worker only if load evidence requires it.
Budgets, storage, timeouts, provider enable flags; secret refs via env.

steps: Daily discovery for active sources; configurable slower archival scans; re-extract only changed bytes or explicit schema/model upgrade.
One scheduler lease per job; retry with jitter; quarantine repeated failures, never infinite retry loops.
Default worker concurrency1, bounded memory/PDF pages, model-token budget per run; configure actual budgets after P00 measurements.
Metrics expose backlog, coverage, failures and budget exhaustion. API availability must not depend on running research jobs.
tests: Process kill/resume, API 429/outage, credential expiry, storage-full and duplicate-scheduler scenarios.
New company picked up without editing source code; unchanged documents not recharged for LLM extraction.
Health remains available during bounded backfill.
completion_evidence: load test and measured safe deployment limits
